verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Greenhouse using AI to draft job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes in a recruiter's tone. The bulk outreach campaigns item describes automated, personalized sending at scale, not AI-written copy. The AI features that are documented (Notetaker interview summaries, Voice AI interviews, Talent Matching, Offer Forecast, report filters) are different capabilities and don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
